visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular male character sits centrally in a bright gym environment, speaking directly to the camera. He is wearing a black ribbed tank top that highlights his physique and tattoos on both forearms. A lapel microphone is clipped to his chest, and a silver necklace hangs around his neck. The gym background features various weight machines and cable equipment, slightly blurred with a shallow depth of field. (2) The scene transitions to a medium-side shot of the man standing in a dimly lit part of the gym, performing lateral raises with dumbbells. He is wearing a black weightlifting belt over a dark graphic tank top. The lighting is more dramatic here, casting shadows that emphasize his muscle definition. (3) The video returns to the initial seated position. The man continues speaking with calm but purposeful facial expressions, occasionally moving his hands to emphasize his words. The indoor lighting is even and bright, highlighting his skin texture and the details of his khaki cargo pants. (4) As the man discusses specific promotions, text overlays appear across the screen. He uses various hand gestures, such as pointing with his index finger and making a fist, to punctuate the sales points. The background remains the consistent, well-organized gym interior with professional fitness equipment visible behind him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice with a deep, resonant pitch and clear articulation begins the video with a professional greeting. The speech rate is moderate and rhythmic. Background music consists of a soft acoustic-pop track featuring light guitar strums and a steady, gentle drum beat. The audio quality is studio-clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio and virtually no ambient floor noise. (2) As the visual shifts to the workout montage, the vocal disappears, and the BGM volume swells slightly to fill the space. The music maintains its mid-tempo energy. Faint, percussive transients corresponding to the weight movements are barely audible beneath the music track, acting as organic incidental sounds. (3) The narration resumes as the man explains his diet and brand choice. His voice remains assertive yet friendly, with natural pauses for breath. The BGM continues as a steady bed, sitting well below the vocal frequency range. The overall mix is well-balanced, emphasizing the mid-low vocal frequencies for a sense of authority. (4) The audio energy increases for the final promotional segment. The narrator's speech rate speeds up slightly, and the pitch variability increases to convey excitement. Each new promotional text overlay is accompanied by a sharp, digital UI 'ding' or 'pop' sound effect. These transients are crisp and high-frequency, cutting through the mix to grab the listener's attention before the music fades out at the conclusion.
